an7.32:3.2: “Tonight, a glorious deity, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, came to me, bowed, stood to one side, and said to me:
an7.32:3.3: ‘Sir, these seven things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant.
an7.32:3.5: Respect for the Teacher, for the teaching, for the Saṅgha, for the training, for immersion, for diligence, and for hospitality—
an7.32:3.6: These seven things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant.’
an7.32:3.8: Then he bowed and respectfully circled me, keeping me on his right side, before vanishing right there.
